A composite illustration of agricultural infrastructures divided into four quadrants. Top-left: a paved rural road with a small truck carrying bags of produce (transport). Top-right: a tall radio transmission mast beside a farmer listening to a portable radio (communication). Bottom-left: a concrete dam holding back a reservoir, with irrigation canals flowing into a green vegetable field (water). Bottom-right: a group of tall cylindrical metal silos for storing grain (storage).

A diagram illustrating the Land Use Act of 1978. A map of a Nigerian state is at the top, pointing to a figure holding a document. An arrow points from the Governor to a "Farmer" receiving a certificate. A signpost next to the farmer reads "Maximum limit: 500 ha for crops, 5000 ha for grazing".
